channel.title: Clean macOS Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for Clean macOS

item.title: Version 1.0.42
item.description:
• Screen Record now shows a live preview of the screen, window or app before and while you record
  • New recording settings: resolution (Full, 1080p, 720p), frame rate (24, 30, 60 fps) and the folder videos are saved to
  • Change the source or cancel from the preview without creating a file

item.title: Version 1.0.41
item.description:
• New Screen Record page: record a screen, a window or an app with system audio and your microphone, saved as MP4 in Movies (macOS 15 or later)
  • Stop a recording from the page or from the menu bar
  • System audio and microphone are mixed into one sound track, so the video plays everywhere

item.title: Version 1.0.40
item.description:
• Home no longer lags the screen when left open: GPU use drops from about 75% to under 5%
  • The colorful background on Home and About stays still instead of drifting

item.title: Version 1.0.39
item.description:
• Home no longer slows the screen down when left open: CPU use drops from about 50% to about 1%
  • The warning icon on Home bounces once instead of pulsing forever
  • Lighter CPU and memory charts that look the same

item.title: Version 1.0.38
item.description:
• Power recovery now follows how your Mac really starts up: power on, log in without a password, your Login Items, your background jobs, then lock the screen
  • Background jobs: add your own command or one-click presets — keep the screen on, keep the Mac awake, awake on power, mute at login
  • Set how many seconds after login the screen locks, even when an existing job does the locking
  • Power Recovery shortcut on Home
  • Much lower CPU use: animated backgrounds and flow lines now run in Core Animation

item.title: Version 1.0.37
item.description:
• New Settings › Startup: a step-by-step flow that brings your Mac back on its own after a power cut — turn on when power returns, log in, open your apps (keep, hide or quit them after a few seconds), lock the screen and keep it awake
  • Administrator access is asked only when you change a setting that needs it

item.title: Version 1.0.36
item.description: • Ports & Jobs: select a port or running job to see its folder, CPU and memory, what started it, and how long it has run

item.title: Version 1.0.35
item.description:
• React to Jira comments with 👍 ❤️ 😂 🎉 👀 — hover a comment to pick one, click again to remove it
  • Your first comment on a task can now be edited and deleted

item.title: Version 1.0.34
item.description: • About now shows how many times Clean macOS has been downloaded

item.title: Version 1.0.33
item.description:
• Opening a task from a notification or the menu bar no longer pins the window to every desktop — it comes to the current one and stays there
  • The menu bar popup now closes when you open a task or the app from it

item.title: Version 1.0.32
item.description:
• Jira task panel is split into tabs: Details, Comments, Linked, Files and Activity, with live counts
  • The task panel edge now shows a grip so it is clear you can drag it wider (double-click to reset)

item.title: Version 1.0.31
item.description:
• Jira notifications now cover every change others make on tasks you work on, report or watch — status, priority, sprint, points, links, attachments and more — with who made it
  • Comments on tasks you report or watch now notify you too; bursts of updates are grouped into one notification
  • Each Jira status has its own color in the table, board and task panel

item.title: Version 1.0.30
item.description:
• Jira: every task now shows an Activity log — who changed what and when (status, assignees, reviewers, sprint, points…)
  • Jira: press ⌘↩ to send a comment, save an edited comment or save the description

item.title: Version 1.0.29
item.description:
• Jira: get notified when people join or leave a task you are on
  • Jira settings are simpler: paste any Jira link and a token, then pick your project — Cloud/Server and the board are detected for you
  • Less-used Jira options moved under Advanced

item.title: Version 1.0.28
item.description:
• Redesigned Clean Disk: a clear overview with disk usage and what is ready to clean, category filters, project paths under every item, a live scan progress view and a bottom bar to review and clean
  • Fixed clicking a row in Clean Disk clearing the items you had checked; deleting a Time Machine snapshot now asks first and no longer freezes the app
  • Dev Tools can now update outdated Homebrew formulae, casks and global npm packages, one by one or all at once
  • New About page with the real app icon, Check for Updates and shortcuts to every tool

item.title: Version 1.0.27
item.description:
• New Dev Tools page: every Node.js, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, Rust, Bun and Deno you installed (nvm, fnm, pyenv, asdf, mise, Homebrew…), which one your Terminal uses, Homebrew formulae and casks, and global npm, bun, go and cargo tools — with sizes, update hints and uninstall
  • New Login Items tab in Ports & Jobs: turn apps that open at login on and off, add apps, and clean up entries for apps you already deleted

item.title: Version 1.0.26
item.description: • The Jira token is now stored in a private file on your Mac instead of the Keychain, so updates no longer ask for your Keychain password. You may see the Keychain prompt one last time while the token moves over.

item.title: Version 1.0.25
item.description:
• Brand-new Home: live CPU, memory and disk with charts, a health summary, Jira sprint and in-progress tasks, cleanable breakdown and quick tools with live counts
  • Sidebar sub-tabs now slide open and closed smoothly

item.title: Version 1.0.24
item.description: • Fixed Delete, Turn Off, Stop and Quit in Ports & Jobs doing nothing after confirming

item.title: Version 1.0.23
item.description:
• Redesigned permission screen: clearer steps, detects access automatically, Quit & Reopen button
  • Explains why access must be granted again after each update (free app without a paid Apple Developer signature) and how to fix an entry that already looks ON

item.title: Version 1.0.22
item.description:
• Ports & Jobs: detail panel with full command, uptime and live log tail; right-click menus; stop or delete jobs (plist goes to the Trash)
  • Settings is split into sidebar sub-tabs: General, Cleaning, Clipboard, Jira, Updates
  • Fixed display tiles drifting off-center in the Displays arrangement

item.title: Version 1.0.21
item.description:
• New Ports & Jobs page: see which ports are listening and which process holds them, open them in the browser, or quit the process
  • Scheduled Jobs: list your LaunchAgents and crontab with readable schedules and live status; run now, turn off/on, open log or reveal the plist

item.title: Version 1.0.20
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.20

  • Clear update prompt — when a new version is ready, a large window shows what's new with a one-click Restart to Update button.
  • Faster update checks — the app checks for a new version as soon as it opens.

item.title: Version 1.0.19
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.19

  • Jira lists in the sidebar — Sprint, Doing, All tasks, Done (with counts) and Table/Board now sit right under Jira in the app sidebar.
  • Reply to bugs without leaving the task — click a linked bug to see its latest comments and reply inline (⌘↩ to send). The ↗ button opens the bug, with a back button to the parent task.
  • Clearer sub-tasks — rounded tree lines connect sub-tasks to their parent in the table.
  • Easier Jira setup — without a token, the Jira tab shows the connect form right there.

item.title: Version 1.0.18
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.18

  • Live Jira updates — new comments and changes made by others appear in the open task within about 10 seconds, no reload needed. If you're typing or editing, only the comment list updates so nothing you type is lost.
  • Task list stays fresh — rows for changed tasks update automatically.

item.title: Version 1.0.17
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.17

  • Friendlier comment box — mentions show as @Name and attached images as thumbnails under the box; Clean macOS converts them to Jira syntax when you send. Drafts are kept while you edit other fields.
  • Edit and delete comments — hover your own comment for Edit · Delete (delete asks you to click twice).
  • Comment images fixed — images in comments now load inside the app; click one to view it full size.
  • Release history fixed — the popover no longer collapses while loading.

item.title: Version 1.0.16
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.16

  • Release history — click the version button at the bottom-left of the sidebar to see every release and what changed, with your current version marked.

item.title: Version 1.0.15
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.15

  • Faster update checks — Clean macOS now checks for new versions every hour instead of once a day.
  • Update notice — when a new version is out, a notice slides in at the corner of the window with Update / Later.
  • Install automatically — new option in Settings → Updates to download and install updates in the background.

item.title: Version 1.0.14
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.14

  • Attachments — see a task's files as thumbnails, drag and drop or browse to attach, click an image to view it full size.
  • Upload progress — a clear loading indicator while images and files upload.
  • Keyboard picking — use ↑ ↓ and Enter to choose people in @mentions and the Add-person box.
  • Fix — images added to comments now show up in Jira (they go on their own line).

item.title: Version 1.0.13
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.13

  • Formatting toolbar — bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, headings, lists, code, quotes and links for Jira descriptions and comments, with ⌘B / ⌘I / ⌘U.
  • Preview — see a description or comment exactly as Jira will show it before saving.
  • Richer display — headings, code blocks, quotes, tables and panels look like they do in Jira.
  • Fix — the image button in comments now opens the file picker.

item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.12

  • Edit people — add or remove Assignees and Reviewers right in the task panel.
  • All task fields — Reporter plus every editable Jira field (Staging, PRD, BA / Designer / Tester Point, KPI Month…), editable in place. The task panel can be resized by dragging its edge.
  • Chat-style comments — your comments on the right, others on the left, with avatars; type @ to mention someone; paste or attach images.
  • Images load — attachments in descriptions and comments now display inside the app.
  • Menu bar — "Recently updated" shows your 3 latest-updated tasks.
  • KPI import — import the KPI sheet as CSV from Settings → Jira.
  • Fixes — "Open in Jira" and links open in your browser; points follow your selected role.

item.title: Version 1.0.11
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.11

  • Fewer Keychain prompts — the Jira token is read from the Keychain once per launch instead of on every screen refresh. Choose "Always Allow" once.

item.title: Version 1.0.10
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.10

  • New icon — black, white and orange, now the same size as other apps in the Dock.
  • Granular cache cleaning — Clean Disk breaks caches down per app and up to 3 levels deep (e.g. Chrome → profile → cache), so you can delete just the part you want.
  • Thumbnails in Large Files — see what each file is at a glance; right-click for Quick Look or Show in Finder.
  • Uninstall fixed for protected apps — apps installed by the App Store or an installer now ask for your administrator password and go to the Trash instead of silently failing.
  • Jira notifications never miss — catches up after sleep or restart, covers all projects, reviewer assignments and mentions in descriptions or edited comments; new "Send Test" button.
  • Compact menu bar — smaller popover with sprint, tasks and system stats at a glance; new "Open at login" option.
  • Security — the Jira view no longer loads scripts from the internet.

item.title: Version 1.0.9
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.9

  • New Jira tab — your Jira tasks inside Clean macOS: table and board, filters, task details, comments, KPI months. Set it up in Settings → Jira (domain + token).
  • Jira in the menu bar — current sprint, days left, this month's progress and your Doing / Review / To do tasks; click a task to open it.
  • Jira notifications — when you're added to a task, someone comments on your task, or mentions you.

item.title: Version 1.0.8
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.8

  • New RAM tab — live process monitor with memory usage; kill a process in one click.
  • Claude Desktop cleanup — scans Claude Desktop caches and Cowork VM bundles.
  • Safer cleaning — reliable per-item deletion, detailed results, drill-down scan; the live system temp folder is no longer picked by Select All.
  • Fixes — menu bar popover opens over fullscreen apps; fixed a UI freeze caused by the menu bar.

item.title: Version 1.0.7
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.7

  • New Displays tab — manage your monitors in one place: see how they're arranged and drag to rearrange them, or set a different display as the main one.
  • Per-monitor wallpaper — pick a separate wallpaper for each screen, with Fill / Fit / Stretch / Center scaling and a background color.

item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.6

  • Closing the window now keeps Clean macOS running in the background — your clipboard history and the ⌘⇧V picker keep working. Click the Dock icon to reopen the window; ⌘Q quits fully.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.5

  • The clipboard picker (⌘⇧V) now opens over full-screen apps and is ready to type into immediately — no extra click needed.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.4

  • Clipboard history — a new Clipboard tab keeps the text you copy; press ⌘⇧V anywhere to pick an earlier copy and paste it (auto-paste needs Accessibility).
  • New Home — a calm dashboard hub; the scan & clean workflow now lives in its own Clean Disk tab.
  • Refreshed interface — a softer, more consistent look across every screen.

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.3

  • Bug fixes and improvements.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
What's new in 1.0.2

  • Enables automatic in-place updates via Sparkle — future versions install themselves, no reinstall needed.
